image_prompt.text: Bright green grass terrain covering the whole garden zone
Wooden fencing enclosing the full perimeter of the garden
Raised garden plots filled with dark soil, dug in rows across the garden
Walkable dirt paths through the garden linking the barn to the raised beds
Wooden crates and boxes stacked around the garden
A scarecrow standing at the centre of the back edge of the garden
A small barn structure at the back of the zone
Decorative trees dotted around the garden

layout_placement.text: Each raised bed is a planting station players return to to sow and harvest
Grain stalks scattered around the garden as the crop harvested here

notes: Zone is roughly 80x80 studs — a stated size with no field in the handoff, so recorded here.
Requested look: colourful and farm-themed, warm cozy palette.
The prompt cites a reference image that was not supplied; the written asset list was used as the whole brief.
Preset matched on what it builds rather than on the word 'simulator': a shared farm worked through repeatable planting tasks is Role Sim, not the shop-and-purchase-gate loop of Incremental Simulator.
Role Sim preset taken with its `path-road-vehicle` option dropped — an 80x80 stud fenced garden has no room for vehicle-width hauling roads.
The barn is treated as a solid structure, not an enterable interior, so this stays on P0 rather than taking `building-interior`'s P3. Say the word and interiors can be noted for later.

would have asked: Sounds like a shared farm zone everyone works in — grass ground fenced all the way round, raised soil beds you plant and tend, dirt paths between them, a scarecrow at the back, a small barn and some trees, with grain scattered about to gather. Want that, or would you rather build it up yourself?
would have asked: Is the barn something players go inside, or just a prop in the scene? Going inside means interiors generated separately, which is a slower build.
would have asked: Anything else you want in the space?
